| description = The first Efreeti in the [[Plane of Sky]] is a formidable foe. Killing Noble Dojorn immediately spawns the [[Overseer of Air]] at the entrance to the windmill on Island 4.

Noble Dojorn has two spawn cycles. One is a fixed seven day timer, which starts upon his death. The second is a fixed three day timer, which starts upon his death only if the [[Overseer of Air]] that spawns is left alive. Both spawn cycles can be active at once. 

The Three Day Noble spawn location is just offset left of the windmill entrance. When a Three Day Noble spawns, the associated Overseer of Air despawns until the Three Day Noble is killed at which point the Overseer of Air respawns. The next Seven Day Noble, when killed, will spawn a new Overseer of Air which will subsequently have a new Three Day Noble cycle associated with it if left alive. There can be multiple Overseer of Air up at once yielding multiple Three Day Noble cycles associated with each Overseer.

=== Strategy ===

ND has two guardian blade storms. Can be split from them and pulled solo to a different island.

High resists, not normally slowable, does not DT. Can quad if wielding a [[Stein of Flowing Ichor]] or a weapon in off hand.
